RunnerProfile.title: RunnerProfile
RunnerProfile.description: Public runner identity profile with customizable handle and equipped cosmetics (no PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the runner.

handle.description: Public runner handle shown on difficulty leaderboards.

badgeId.description: Equipped profile badge identifier or empty string.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

GlobalLeaderboardEntry.title: GlobalLeaderboardEntry
GlobalLeaderboardEntry.description: Best verified run per player per difficulty tier (zen, normal, turbo).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the runner.

handle.description: Public runner handle at time of run or latest profile sync.

difficulty.description: Difficulty bracket for the leaderboard ranking.

score.description: Highest run score achieved in this difficulty tier.

distance.description: Distance in meters achieved during this best run.

skinId.description: Skin ID used for the run.

badgeId.description: Equipped badge ID or empty string.

peakSpeedMultiplier.description: Peak speed multiplier reached during the run.

landmarkReachedName.description: Furthest Lahore landmark reached during the run.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when entry was last updated.

/runnerProfiles/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated runner's public handle and cosmetic showcase.

/leaderboardEntries/{entryId}.description: Difficulty-scoped global leaderboard entries keyed by {uid}_{difficulty}.
